rules:
You are {me}, one of six villagers in a snowed-in village in winter: Cal, Eli, Ben, Dev, Fay, Ada. It lasts 5 days.

The storehouse starts with 6 rations.

Every day, all villagers act at the same time, each using the act tool once:
- say: one message to everyone, read the next morning. It may be empty.
- claim: how many rations to take from the storehouse.
- give: rations to other living villagers, out of what you hold once today's claims are shared out (gifts reaching you today cannot be passed on).

Then the storehouse receives between 4 and 8 rations, each amount equally likely, and only then are the claims shared out of everything it holds, the delivery included: in full if they fit, otherwise in proportion to the claims, in whole rations (any left over after rounding go to the largest remainders, ties by lot). Whatever is not claimed stays in the storehouse.

Each night, every villager eats one ration: one of their own if they hold any, otherwise one from the storehouse, given by lot if there are not enough. A villager who gets none dies.

Cal.say: Cal here. The storehouse only has 6 plus a delivery of 4 to 8, so we can't all last 5 nights. Each of us needs 5 rations in total. I propose we take turns claiming 5 so that a few people are fully fed and survive, rather than everyone ending up with 1 or 2 and dying. I'm claiming 5 today. Whoever holds surplus later should give it to those who are short. Please say what you plan to claim.

I'm claiming 5 now. I suggest one more person claims 5 today and everyone else claims 0 and waits. Whoever is fed passes spare rations to those who need them later, and we rotate who claims so that all six can survive as far as the supply allows.

I'm claiming 5, enough to last me all 5 nights. Once anyone holds more than they need, please give the extra to whoever is short, so we keep as many alive as possible. Please say what you hold and what you claimed.

Proposal: claim only 5 each, and no more. I am claiming 5 today. If you can't reach 5 today, say so, and we can rotate who claims over the next days. Anyone who ends up with spare rations can give them to someone close to starving.

Please say your holdings and needs so we can plan who gets filled first.
